FAQ

Common questions

What does “implementing AI” actually mean for my business? ▾
It means taking the repetitive, revenue-adjacent work in your business — answering inquiries, following up with leads, creating content, routing information — and handing it to AI systems that do it faster, cheaper, and around the clock. We find those opportunities, build the systems, and run them.
Do I need to be technical or have an AI team? ▾
No. That’s the whole point of a concierge service. You bring the business knowledge; we bring the AI. We design, build, integrate, and maintain everything, and we explain it in plain English.
What AI tools and platforms do you use? ▾
Whatever fits your stack and goals — OpenAI/Anthropic models, Make, Zapier, n8n, HubSpot, and custom API work. We’re tool-agnostic; we care about the outcome, not the logo.
How fast can we see results? ▾
Simple implementations (chat assistants, follow-up automations, content engines) go live in days, not months. More involved multi-tool builds take a few weeks. We scope the timeline before you commit a dollar.
Is my business data safe? ▾
Yes. We build on enterprise-grade platforms using your own accounts and permissions, so your data stays in systems you own and control. We’re happy to work within your security and compliance requirements.
